pedro-lopes--generative-muscle-stimulati.why_en: Ask the AI for help and it answers by moving your own hand through your muscles.
pedro-lopes--generative-muscle-stimulati.why_zh: 向 AI 求助，它不用说话，而是通过肌肉电刺激直接带着你的手去做。

zhuoyue-lyu--clook.why_en: A clock that watches you: time speeds up when you look away and stops while people talk.
zhuoyue-lyu--clook.why_zh: 一只会看人的钟：你不看它时时间变快，有人聊天时时间停下。

maarten-baas--schiphol-peoples-clock.why_en: The hands of a giant clock are people, one after another, showing the time with their bodies.
maarten-baas--schiphol-peoples-clock.why_zh: 巨大时钟的指针是一个接一个的真人，用身体摆出时间。

christo-jeanne-claude--the-gates-ar.why_en: A vanished artwork returns to the exact paths in Central Park where it once stood.
christo-jeanne-claude--the-gates-ar.why_zh: 一件早已拆除的作品，回到它当年所在的中央公园小径上。

stijn-spanhove--broadcast-to-xr-basketba.why_en: Last night's televised play happens again, in 3D, on the court you are standing on.
stijn-spanhove--broadcast-to-xr-basketba.why_zh: 昨晚电视里的那一球，在你脚下的球场上以 3D 重新打一遍。

cayden-pierce--caption-glasses.why_en: Subtitles for real life, floating next to the person who is speaking.
cayden-pierce--caption-glasses.why_zh: 给现实生活加字幕，字幕就浮在说话的人旁边。

makeability-lab--cookar.why_en: Kitchen tools glow safe where you can grab them and warn where they can hurt you.
makeability-lab--cookar.why_zh: 厨具上能抓的地方亮起安全色，会伤人的地方亮起警告色。

anhphu-nguyen--i-xray.why_en: Look at a stranger and their name and address appear, showing how exposed everyone already is.
anhphu-nguyen--i-xray.why_zh: 看一眼陌生人，他的名字和住址就浮现出来，揭示每个人早已暴露到什么程度。

koki-ibukuro--myaku-myaku-ar.why_en: A vase of flowers turns into a wobbling blob covered in eyes while the rest of the room stays real.
koki-ibukuro--myaku-myaku-ar.why_zh: 一瓶花变成布满眼睛、晃来晃去的团子，房间其余部分保持原样。

fabrice-matulic--talking-objects.why_en: Every household object gets a face and a personality that come from what it is.
fabrice-matulic--talking-objects.why_zh: 每件家居物品都长出一张脸，性格由它本身是什么来决定。

stijn-spanhove--action-figure-to-life.why_en: Photograph a toy and a living copy of it walks around next to the real one.
stijn-spanhove--action-figure-to-life.why_zh: 给玩偶拍张照，一个活过来的它就在真玩偶旁边走来走去。

laura-schutz--sonify-anything.why_en: A virtual ball sounds like glass, wood or metal depending on the real thing it hits.
laura-schutz--sonify-anything.why_zh: 虚拟的球撞到玻璃、木头还是金属，就发出对应材质的声音。

anthony-mccall--solid-light-tate.why_en: A projected beam becomes a solid-looking volume that you walk into and cut with your body.
anthony-mccall--solid-light-tate.why_zh: 投影光束变成看似实体的空间，你走进去，用身体把它切开。

jr--la-caverne-du-pont-neuf.why_en: Paris's oldest bridge disappears inside a rock cave.
jr--la-caverne-du-pont-neuf.why_zh: 巴黎最古老的桥消失在一座岩洞里。

xavi-bou--entomographies.why_en: The flight of an insect is left behind as a glowing line in the air.
xavi-bou--entomographies.why_zh: 昆虫飞过的路径，在空中留下一条发光的线。

makeability-lab--earll.why_en: Pick up an everyday object and its word in the language you are learning appears.
makeability-lab--earll.why_zh: 拿起一件日常物品，它在你正在学的语言里的名字就出现在眼前。
